galaxy_rotation.verdict: Baryonic-only fails flat rotation curves (large decline at large r). Both the fitted NFW dark-halo model and the fitted pressure-gradient (DUP) model reproduce the flat curve. The pressure model achieves this WITHOUT dark matter — that is the theory's positive claim, and its discriminators are: (1) higher-precision data, (2) bulge/disk mass uncertainties, (3) independent probes (lensing, CMB).
